༄༅/ /chos kyi rje rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa kun dga' rin chen gyi gsung 'bum pod (nga)pa'i dkar chag bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /chos kyi rje rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa kun dga' rin chen gyi gsung 'bum pod (nga)pa'i dkar chag bzhugs so//

ka) dam chos dgongs pa gcig pa'i khog dbub sa'i don bsdus pa /kha) dam chos dgongs pa gcig pa'i lta sgom spyod gsum gyi rnam par bzhag pa/ ga) dam chos dgongs pa gcig pa'i dka' gnad kyi zhu don dri ma med pa'i sgron me/ nga) dam chos dgongs pa gcig pa'i dri lan 'od stong ldan pa/ ca) dam pa'i chos 'dul ba'i bslab bya mdor bsdus/ cha) phyag rgya chen po lnga ldan gsal byed nor bu'i phreng ba nyams su blang bde ba/ ja) phyag rgya chen po lnga ldan nor bu'i phreng ba'i gsal byed/ nya) phyag rgya chen po lnga ldan gyi khrid yig yid bzhin gyi nor bu skye dgu'i re skong*/ ta) phyag rgya chen po lnga ldan gyi khrid spyan snga ā nanda ratnas 'chug med du bsgrigs pa/ tha) phyag rgya chen po lhan cig skyes sbyor gyi khrid kyi zin bris/ da) phyag rgya chen po lhan cig skyes sbyor lta ba'i mig 'byed/ na) phyag chen chos drug brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs rigs bdag ma/ pa) zab lam nā ro chos drug gi khrid kyi zin bris/ pha) zab lam nā ro chos drug gi lhan thabs sbas don kun gsal/ ba) lam zab bla ma'i rnal 'byor mos gus srog 'khor gyi dbang khrid/ ma) lam zab bla ma'i rnal 'byor byin rlabs kyi gter mdzod/
